title: Bolt for Business Review (2026)
intro: Bolt for Business is evaluated here as a unified people platform (HR + payroll + IT modules) — Bolt for Business is a corporate ground-transport account for teams — employees book rides via the Bolt app under company billing, with ride history, limits, and admin controls. Pricing is usage-based per trip (2026-08-19), not a traditional per-seat HR SaaS subscription. Scored as HR/finance-ops adjacent mobility — not HRIS, travel management, or expense suite depth like Navan. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Bolt for Business when employee ground transport with central billing is the job.
verdict: Choose Bolt for Business when employee ground transport with central billing is the job. Compare Navan for full travel and expense; Uber for Business in overlapping cities. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.
